deepdive.thesis: Siemens Energy India is uniquely positioned as the only pure-play, end-to-end energy infrastructure player in India, benefiting from the country's $1T+ energy transformation plan — doubling power capacity to 1,000 GW by 2030, requiring massive transmission build-out, grid stabilization, and industrial electrification. With a 162B INR order book and 49% order growth, it is executing on structural tailwinds while expanding its global manufacturing hub role.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.

With a 162B INR order book and 49% order growth, it is executing on structural tailwinds while expanding its global manufacturing hub role.
